title: Real-Time Logistics Tracking Dashboard (Phase 1)
problem: Fleet managers lacked live visibility into 1,200 active freight trucks across 4 states.
solution: Architected a Next.js 14 frontend with map rendering and FastAPI SSE streaming server.
outcome_metrics: Streamed sub-second telemetry updates with 99.98% uptime; reduced dispatch inquiry tickets by 45%.

title: Multi-Tenant B2B SaaS Billing Platform (Phase 1)
problem: SaaS startup had manual billing workflows resulting in 18% delayed invoice collections.
solution: Engineered automated Stripe Billing integration with webhooks, seat management, and usage metering.
outcome_metrics: Automated 100% of recurring invoicing; reduced dunning churn by 28% within 90 days.

title: High-Performance E-Commerce Headless Storefront (Phase 1)
problem: Legacy monolithic storefront suffered 4.8s mobile load times and 68% bounce rates.
solution: Built headless Next.js frontend with Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) and Edge caching.
outcome_metrics: Lighthouse performance score jumped from 38 to 96; mobile checkout conversion rose by 32%.

title: HIPAA-Compliant Patient Portal (Phase 1)
problem: Medical practice needed secure patient appointment booking, messaging, and lab records portal.
solution: Implemented AES-256 encrypted fields, OAuth2/OIDC role-based access control, and audit trail logging.
outcome_metrics: Onboarded 8,500 active patients in 6 months with zero security findings in SOC2 audit.

title: Collaborative Document Annotation Canvas (Phase 1)
problem: Teachers needed interactive live PDF grading and markup tool for remote classrooms.
solution: Engineered WebSockets synchronization layer with CRDT conflict resolution on HTML5 Canvas.
outcome_metrics: Handled 50 simultaneous student drawing streams per session at 60fps with zero desync.
